summary: Feed s100_single is degraded: 17.1% of frames truncated (mostly to 128 bytes) prevents NDR full-payload inspection. All other visibility checks healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker has packet slicing / snap-length enabled at ~128 bytes, cutting payload from frames before delivery to tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection, signature matching and anomaly detection; truncated frames hide application payload and reduce detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs_full_payload=true - disable slicing (or set snaplen >=9216 to match tool max_frame_bytes) to deliver complete frames for analysis.
